disposition_reason: Single zinc, chromium, cadmium, iron and copper values for baked beans collected in Jere LGA, Borno State, Nigeria, by AAS (Table 1).

study.market: Mairi Kuwait, Jere Local Government Area, Borno State, Nigeria
study.method: HCl/HNO3 digestion of 1 g dried sample; AAS

findings.group: Mairi Kuwait, Jere LGA, Borno State
findings.notes: Single result per metal; number of samples not stated. 1 g of 'dried sample' digested, so basis taken as dry. Cd 3 mg/kg by flame AAS is implausibly high for beans.
